verifiedRecords.theorem: KMW Theorem 20 and Corollary 21; simultaneous min-form also stated in Harris Section 7
verifiedRecords.probability: Includes randomized algorithms measured by expected approximation; therefore also constrains deterministic and high-probability constant-factor guarantees
verifiedRecords.notes: Transfer: give weight 1 to every edge of a KMW hard instance. Then total matching weight equals matching cardinality, so a weighted constant-factor algorithm would solve the original unweighted task with unchanged rounds. This is an existence-of-hard-instances bound, not a claim for every graph or a tight dependence on ε. The simultaneous min-form is quoted explicitly in Harris Section 7.
